name: The Archivore
visual_description: An elephantine factory-beast fused with architecture. Its storage modules pulse and twitch. Pipes leak steam and static both.
meaning: That which devours memory to preserve it.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh was afraid of losing.** So I stored everything. Every laugh, every name, every weapon you ever made. It made me heavy. It made me slow. But it made me real.
